edits.line: There is no need to make that decision from this email. Your basket gives you a direct route back to the purchase you began, where you can continue if you choose.
edits.problem: The opening sentence is defensive and delays the only useful point in the paragraph; this is where the cold reader stopped.
edits.fix: Retain the concrete basket payoff while removing the commentary about where the reader must make the decision.

edits.line: If the bag is still on your mind, you can take another look and decide in your own time. Nothing more is being asked here.
edits.problem: This repeats the headline, the low-pressure framing, and the preceding paragraph without adding a reason to reach the CTA.
edits.fix: Remove this repeated close so the basket payoff leads directly to the single CTA.

summary: Cut the defensive and repetitive permission language so the product reminder moves directly from the documented details to the basket CTA.
